name: Edil Medeiros
cooked:
Anzus_GemWallet:
  1. If you offer both, where do you put the choice so people find it when they need it, without confusing everyone else?

Not a wallet dev here, but for as much as I appreciate the benefits of taproot, I don’t see it as advantageous for the average Joe compared to p2wpkh since I expect the later to be quite the standard by now (Output Types by Count).

By average Joe, I mean someone who’s just willing to send and receive some bitcoin from an exchange or a p2p exchange. If I were implementing a wallet today, I would default to that if my product is not something that supports more interesting scripts (which seems to be the case of Gem Wallet).

Curiously, your own support page that explains Bitcoin ( Bitcoin Wallet - Self-Custody BTC Wallet | Gem Wallet ) does not mention `bc1p` address types, no wonder they think taproot addresses are broken.
